passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: This is my body, and I have a head.
phrases.ko: 이것은 나의 몸이고, 나에게는 머리가 있어요.
phrases.zh: 这是我的身体，我有一个头。
phrases.py: zhè shì wǒ de shēn tǐ， wǒ yǒu yí gè tóu。

phrases.en: I shut one eye, and I hear with my ear.
phrases.ko: 나는 한쪽 눈을 감고, 귀로 들어요.
phrases.zh: 我闭上一只眼睛，用耳朵听。
phrases.py: wǒ bì shàng yī zhī yǎn jīng， yòng ěr duǒ tīng。

phrases.en: I open my mouth when I sing.
phrases.py: wǒ chàng gē de shí hòu zhāng kāi zuǐ。

phrases.en: I wave my hand, and I hop on one foot.
phrases.ko: 나는 손을 흔들고, 한 발로 뛰어요.
phrases.py: wǒ huī shǒu， yě yòng yī zhī jiǎo tiào。

phrases.en: I move my body every day.
phrases.py: wǒ měi tiān huó dòng shēn tǐ。
jiàn kāng de shēn tǐ hěn qiáng zhuàng。

phrases.en: I wash my hands before I eat.
phrases.py: chī fàn qián wǒ xǐ shǒu。

phrases.en: My two eyes help me read.
phrases.ko: 나의 두 눈은 내가 책을 읽도록 도와줘요.
phrases.zh: 我的两只眼睛帮助我看书。
phrases.py: wǒ de liǎng zhī yǎn jīng bāng zhù wǒ kàn shū。

phrases.en: I take care of my body because I want to be strong.
phrases.zh: 我想变得强壮，所以我照顾自己的身体。
phrases.py: wǒ xiǎng biàn de qiáng zhuàng， suǒ yǐ wǒ zhào gù zì jǐ de shēn tǐ。

phrases.en: A healthy girl can run and play.
phrases.ko: 건강한 여자아이는 달리고 놀 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 健康的女孩可以跑，也可以玩。
phrases.py: jiàn kāng de nǚ hái kě yǐ pǎo， yě kě yǐ wán。

phrases.en: I move, I rest, and I grow.
phrases.zh: 我活动，我休息，我也长大。
phrases.py: wǒ huó dòng， wǒ xiū xī， wǒ yě zhǎng dà。

full_passage_spoken: This is my body, and I have a head. I shut one eye, and I hear with my ear. I open my mouth when I sing. I wave my hand, and I hop on one foot. I move my body every day. A healthy body is strong. I wash my hands before I eat. My two eyes help me read. I take care of my body because I want to be strong. A healthy girl can run and play. I move, I rest, and I grow.
full_passage_zh: 这是我的身体，我有一个头。我闭上一只眼睛，用耳朵听。我唱歌的时候张开嘴。我挥手，也用一只脚跳。我每天活动身体。健康的身体很强壮。吃饭前我洗手。我的两只眼睛帮助我看书。我想变得强壮，所以我照顾自己的身体。健康的女孩可以跑，也可以玩。我活动，我休息，我也长大。
